root_cause: The generic targeted-route verifier required body to be Playwright-visible before collecting HTTP/canonical/content/asset evidence. On /prijzen this generic prerequisite timed out and skipped the specialized pricing interaction verifier, which is the authoritative owner of visual visibility and clickability.
prevention: Generic route verification waits for body attachment and evaluates HTTP status, route identity, content presence, page errors and failed assets.
Visual visibility and clickability are owned by specialized browser gates for the affected interaction.
A generic route gate may not preempt a more specific interaction gate with an unrelated visibility prerequisite.
Pricing remains fail-closed: production closure still requires actual lifecycle, plan-tab, billing and English-route interaction proof.
